statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail 10 sits in the low band while Stress 45 remains elevated; the published danger window spans 12:30Z-15:00Z.
recommendation: The deterministic mapping holds at EA_ON, and Tail eases one point from the previous assessment because the single amplifier cited an hour ago has since been removed rather than confirmed. NQ extended the overnight high only marginally, from 29,654.75 to 29,660.50, failed to hold it, and has given back roughly 60 points to trade near 29,599. That is a second completed retracement layered on the first, in which the entire post-earnings impulse from 29,654.75 to 29,401.75 was surrendered before the low was rejected. Persistent no-retracement structure is exactly what this score measures, and the observed path is its opposite. Cross-assets offer no confirmation either: VIX is 14.90 against a 15.21 close, WTI is unchanged at 82.22 after a run of softer sessions with the reported Iran-Oman Hormuz framework easing the supply narrative, and the latest published H.15 constant maturities of 2Y 4.17% and 10Y 4.64% sit some six to seven basis points below the prior reading. The forward path lifts Tail into the watch band only for the 13:00Z and 14:00Z slots covering the U.S. cash open and the first full cash hour of Nvidia repricing, and the danger window is kept narrow at 12:30Z-15:00Z around the jobless-claims release and that opening sequence. Stress remains elevated on the event stack rather than on any observed failure of mean reversion, and steps down through the U.S. afternoon before rebuilding into Friday's scheduled Jackson Hole keynote.
headline: Marginal new high at 29,660.50 not held: Tail eases to 10, Stress 45 into jobless claims and the Nvidia cash-open repricing
body: Nasdaq-100 September futures trade near 29,599.25, up about 309.75 points or 1.06%, as of 10:16Z against a previous close of 29,289.50, with an overnight range of 29,401.75 to 29,660.50. An independent quote timed a little earlier shows 29,615.00, up 1.11%, on a range of 29,401.75 to 29,662.00, so the two references agree on both the direction and the structure. The governing observation has strengthened since the previous assessment. An hour ago price sat close to the session extreme, which was treated as a single amplifier worth one point of Tail. Since then the high was extended only marginally and immediately rejected, and price has backed away by roughly 60 points. The session therefore now contains two completed give-backs: the full 253-point retracement of the post-earnings impulse from 29,654.75 to 29,401.75, and this smaller failure at the new high. Mean reversion is visibly functioning on both scales, so Tail returns to 10. Nvidia reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of 96.2 billion dollars, up 106% year over year, with data-centre revenue of 89.0 billion dollars, GAAP diluted earnings of 2.46 dollars and third-quarter guidance of 108.0 billion dollars plus or minus 2%, and the shares are indicated up roughly 6% to 7% premarket. That is the session's directional anchor and it explains the gap, but a gap that is repeatedly retraced is a repricing rather than a one-way path. Cross-asset evidence is uniformly calm. VIX is 14.90, down 0.31 points or 2.04% from a 15.21 close, inside a narrow 14.80 to 14.98 range. WTI is 82.22 dollars, essentially unchanged, and Brent is 88.27 dollars, up 0.49%, after a sequence of softer sessions accompanying reported Iranian and Omani agreement on Strait of Hormuz revenue sharing and a joint navigational corridor; that is a de-escalation headline, not a discontinuity. The most recent published H.15 constant-maturity readings stand at 4.17% for the two-year and 4.64% for the ten-year, roughly six to seven basis points below the prior session, which is an easing rather than an equity-hostile impulse. None of yields, volatility, energy or breadth is aligned behind a directional squeeze. The near-term calendar is the reason Stress stays elevated at 45 rather than falling further. Initial and continuing jobless claims, the advance goods trade balance and advance wholesale inventories all release at 12:30Z, the U.S. cash open follows at 13:30Z and brings the first cash repricing of Nvidia's results, Kansas City Fed indices print at 15:00Z and a seven-year note auction settles at 17:00Z. Fed Chair Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote at 14:00Z on Friday. Consistent with the standing contract, those are checkpoints that raise Stress and reduce Confidence rather than automatic Tail blocks, and nothing about them is treated as already observed. The published danger window is deliberately narrow at 12:30Z to 15:00Z, covering the claims release and the opening sequence only. Evidence quality is high: two independent live futures quotes roughly twenty minutes old, a live volatility reading, published official constant-maturity yields, current energy prices and a verified event calendar, which supports Confidence at 88. The shared cross-asset context file available to this assessment carried a collection timestamp more than eight hours old and was therefore treated as stale and excluded from the reasoning; every figure above rests on independently fetched primary sources.

lookbackSummary: Across the past 24 hourly slots Tail moved between 10 and 21 and Stress between 45 and 66, with 21 of 24 hours carrying a published assessment and three hours unavailable. The window covers the pre-Nvidia drift on 26 August, the single watch-band hour at 20:00Z spanning the results release, and the steady decay through the Asian and European sessions as the initial repricing was absorbed. Dominant mode rotated from normal into event/whipsaw around the release and has settled at mixed since 03:00Z, describing a two-sided range rather than a directional trend.
outlookSummary: The forward path keeps the mapped state at EA_ON for 22 of the next 24 hours and lifts Tail into the watch band only at 13:00Z and 14:00Z, covering the U.S. cash open and the first full cash hour of Nvidia repricing. Stress peaks at 60 across the claims release and the opening auction, decays through the U.S. afternoon to 40 overnight, then rebuilds toward 53 by the end of the horizon as Friday's scheduled Jackson Hole keynote approaches. Confidence decays from 88 to 68 with distance from the observed evidence. Every forward reading is conditional risk, not an assertion that any future price structure has been observed.
